title: Solid Biosciences Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Solid Biosciences Inc. (NASDAQ: SLDB) filed a Form 8-K on April 10, 2026, disclosing a board of directors reorganization in which director Ilan Ganot resigned from Class III and was simultaneously appointed to Class I to equalize board membership across the three classes. The company will seek stockholder ratification of this appointment at the 2026 Annual Meeting.
key_points: Director Ilan Ganot resigned from Class III of the Board effective 4:00 PM ET on April 10, 2026
Ganot was simultaneously appointed to fill a vacancy in Class I with a term expiring at the 2028 Annual Meeting
Board decreased Class III directors to three and increased Class I directors to three
Company will seek advisory stockholder ratification of Ganot's Class I appointment at the 2026 Annual Meeting
No changes to Ganot's compensation arrangements resulted from this board reorganization
